operation.description:
Approve or reject pending deployments that are waiting on approval by a required reviewer.

Required reviewers with read access to the repository contents and deployments can use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

comment.description: A comment to accompany the deployment review

environment_ids.description: The list of environment ids to approve or reject

state.description: Whether to approve or reject deployment to the specified environments.

operation.summary: Review pending deployments for a workflow run
